lines.text: Time to make a real game. Every arcade game is built on the same engine: the game loop.
Each frame the game loop updates positions, checks collisions and reacts.
In Scratch, each sprite runs its own forever loop.
When a falling rock leaves the bottom, move it back to the top at a random x.
Touching checks if two sprites overlap.
When the rock hits the player, lose a life and recycle the rock — once per hit.
Lives and score are the game’s state.
Reset them on the green flag so each game starts fair.
Text-based games use exactly the same loop: move, recycle, check collisions.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
